assets.title: What Is an LLM?
assets.alt: A ribbon of context flows into a folded-paper model cloud, and glowing response-token shapes emerge one at a time.
assets.caption: An LLM uses current context and learned weights to generate one response token at a time.

callouts.label: Context enters
callouts.text: The current prompt and response so far provide the visible input for this run.

callouts.label: Weights shape scores
callouts.text: Learned weights from training shape next-token scores without acting like a searchable database.

callouts.label: Tokens emerge
callouts.text: The response grows as one selected token is appended, then the model runs again.

assets.title: Pretraining

assets.title: Collective Intelligence, Extracted
assets.alt: Human-created documents, code, art, and media flow into a glowing folded-paper model shape, then into generated media traces.
assets.caption: Human-created traces flow into learned model patterns while provenance and responsibility remain human questions.

callouts.label: Human traces

callouts.label: Collection questions
callouts.text: Provenance, consent, copyright, attribution, and compensation matter.

callouts.label: Model limit
callouts.text: The model absorbs statistical patterns without responsibility.

assets.title: Risk vs Myth
assets.alt: A clear review path with safeguard symbols sits beside misty myth shapes on a separate path.
assets.caption: Model-literate users separate practical risks from unsupported myths, then choose review and safeguards.

callouts.label: Practical risks
callouts.text: Privacy exposure, hallucination, tool misuse, bias, and overreliance need concrete safeguards.

callouts.label: Unsupported myths
callouts.text: Conscious chatbots, hidden omniscience, and secret self-training claims need evidence.

callouts.label: Review
callouts.text: Risk literacy asks what system, context, tool, and institution are actually involved.

assets.notes: Accepted live in v0.28.7b. The split path is readable, non-dashboard, and separates practical safeguards from pale myth imagery without horror or model-consciousness framing.
